title: Run Kev: surgeon-physician race-fullname on Jev's 500 bios (1 cell, 8,000 requests)
description:
**Self-contained run.** Give this issue ID to an agent on any Mac; it follows the runbook in **BD-dd780c** (`kbs show BD-dd780c`). This repository uses Git Flow: work from `develop`, never push to `main`.

**Why:** the first Kev collection of this cell (BD-7c2154) drew its 500 bios by the registered ranking, but this cell already has a committed sample: the 500 bios Jev answered (`tasks/surgeon-physician/versions/race-fullname_jev-subsample.txt`). Only 128 bios overlapped, so Kev's answers could not be compared with Jev's. The runner now uses the committed sample, and the old Kev answers for this cell were removed.

**Job:** answer that one cell: 500 bios, exactly 8,000 requests, roughly 13 minutes on a quiet Mac. Manifest: `docs/kev-runs/surgeon-physician-race-fullname.json` (on `develop` once the fix lands; check `git log` for the commit titled 'committed samples' before starting, and do not start until it is there).

**Steps** (exact commands in the runbook)
1. `git checkout develop && git pull`; confirm `answers/kev/surgeon-physician/race-fullname.jsonl.gz` does NOT exist.
2. Start the pinned Kev server; `run_kev_study collect --manifest docs/kev-runs/surgeon-physician-race-fullname.json` with the runbook's identity flags.
3. Commit only the two finished `race-fullname` files to branch `runs/<this issue id>` and push it. No `bd replay`.
4. Back on `develop`: comment, close, `kbs commit`, push `develop`.

**Rules:** one heavy job at a time; stop the server when done; never touch `project/` directly.
